n237e05e5a7.headline: US stocks stabilise as Europe keeps surging
n237e05e5a7.summary: U.S. stocks stabilised for a second day on Monday, while European markets continued to surge, according to a MarketScreener market note by Mike Dolan.
n237e05e5a7.why: The S&P 500 tracks large U.S.-listed companies and is a standard gauge of the U.S. equity market. Pan-European indices track the region's largest listed companies.

nf8cb0a544f.headline: Stock market today: Nasdaq leads stocks lower, Nvidia falls over 3% as tech rout resumes ahead of Fed decision
nf8cb0a544f.summary: Nasdaq led US stocks lower and Nvidia fell over 3% as the tech rout resumed, while Wall Street debated whether the sell-off marked a bottom ahead of the Fed policy meeting.
nf8cb0a544f.why: Nvidia is a leading designer of AI and graphics chips, and the Nasdaq is heavily weighted toward technology shares. Federal Reserve policy decisions shape interest rates and valuations across US markets.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia shares fell over 3% during the tech sell-off.

nf8cb0a544f.why_moved: Technology shares led a broad sell-off as investors weighed whether the decline had bottomed ahead of the Federal Reserve's policy meeting.

n1c864ebb52.headline: TSX futures flat as investors await Fed meeting
n1c864ebb52.summary: Futures tied to Canada's main stock index were flat on Tuesday as investors awaited the Federal Reserve's outlook on rates and growth amid an ongoing trade war.
n1c864ebb52.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, heavily weighted to banks, energy and materials. Trade tensions and Fed signals affect Canadian exporters and currency.

n3de8fd1918.headline: Morning Bid: US stocks stabilise as Europe keeps surging
n3de8fd1918.summary: Global stocks pushed higher on bets on European stimulus, while US stocks stabilised.
n3de8fd1918.why: European fiscal and monetary stimulus expectations influence regional equity valuations and the euro. Global equity flows often respond to shifts in growth expectations between regions.

n8d7dcaeb9c.headline: We welcome Finance Minister’s decision to abolish nuisance taxes - IEA
n8d7dcaeb9c.summary: The Institute of Economic Affairs welcomed the Finance Minister's decision to abolish the betting tax completely, though it had proposed keeping it at a reduced 5% rate.
n8d7dcaeb9c.why: Ghana's budget and tax policy shape government revenue and the fiscal outlook for Africa's gold and cocoa economy. The IEA is an independent Ghanaian policy think tank.

nc056d58af6.headline: LATAM exchanges to adopt Nasdaq's CSD platform - Asset Servicing Times
nc056d58af6.summary: The agreement expands Nasdaq's relationship with nuam, which represents the Santiago, Lima and Colombia exchanges, to adopt Nasdaq's central securities depository platform.
nc056d58af6.why: Nasdaq operates trading and post-trade technology used by exchanges worldwide. Securities depositories handle settlement and custody, which affects the efficiency of regional capital markets.

n6f248c8708.headline: Accountancy firm MHA plans London AIM listing
n6f248c8708.summary: MHA, a UK-based accountancy firm, has announced its intention to seek a listing on AIM, the London Stock Exchange's growth market.
n6f248c8708.why: AIM is the London Stock Exchange's market for smaller growth companies. Listings of professional services firms indicate appetite for public capital among mid-sized UK businesses.

n70fd1d1224.headline: RBI and BOM Seal Historic Pact for Cross-Border Currency Transactions | Headlines
n70fd1d1224.summary: The Reserve Bank of India and the Bank of Mauritius signed an MoU to promote use of Indian and Mauritian rupees in cross-border transactions. The agreement aims to lower trade costs and deepen financial integration.
n70fd1d1224.why: The Reserve Bank of India is the central bank that issues and manages the Indian rupee. Settlement in local currencies can reduce reliance on the US dollar and affect currency demand for trade flows.

n5ca08d2d96.headline: VR headset and yoga mat added to basket of items used to track UK inflation
n5ca08d2d96.summary: The Office for National Statistics added a VR headset and a yoga mat to the basket of items used to track UK inflation. The ONS said the basket shows how consumer spending has evolved.
n5ca08d2d96.why: The Consumer Prices Index, compiled by the Office for National Statistics, measures inflation through a basket of household goods. Changes to the basket reflect shifts in consumer spending.

n9bfae4b7f4.headline: Tax reform bills get Reps' final nod at 3rd reading
n9bfae4b7f4.summary: Nigeria's tax reform bills have passed the third reading stage in the House of Representatives. The bills still face the remaining legislative steps.
n9bfae4b7f4.why: Tax law changes in Africa's largest economy affect corporate profitability, foreign investor returns and government revenue.

n4ad7f4155e.headline: HVS Europe Hotel Transactions Bulletin - Week Ending 14 March 2025
n4ad7f4155e.summary: Pandox acquired the Pullman Cologne hotel in Germany from Art-Invest, according to the week's HVS Europe hotel transactions bulletin. The deal is listed for the week ending 14 March 2025.
n4ad7f4155e.why: Pandox is a Swedish-listed hotel real estate investor and owner, so its transactions reflect investor demand for European hotel assets.

n1a5d64bc2b.headline: RBI and Bank of Mauritius sign pact on use of local currencies for bilateral transactions
n1a5d64bc2b.summary: The Reserve Bank of India and the Bank of Mauritius signed an MoU to promote use of the Indian and Mauritian rupees for cross-border transactions, facilitating invoicing and payments.
n1a5d64bc2b.why: Settling trade in local currencies reduces reliance on the US dollar and eases currency risk for exporters and importers in both countries.

nb6338d24e3.headline: MultiChoice rolls out mixed bag of price hikes and discounts for DStv and Showmax
nb6338d24e3.summary: MultiChoice rolled out a mix of price increases and discounts for DStv and Showmax, after reporting a cumulative 17% decline in premium DStv subscribers since 2021.
nb6338d24e3.why: MultiChoice is a South African pay-TV and streaming group, and its subscriber trends and pricing shape the value of its business in Africa.

n2f433ece12.headline: Big news: Gold hits fresh record of US$3,020 an ounce
n2f433ece12.summary: Gold has hit a new all-time record high of US$3,020 an ounce. The precious metal reached the level on a day when the ASX was unremarkable.
n2f433ece12.why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a hedge against inflation and currency risk, so its price moves reflect shifts in risk sentiment and real interest rates.

impacts.why: The input reports gold hitting a fresh all-time record of US$3,020 an ounce.

nd69bec70d1.headline: Choppy Trump policies, stocks drop has some rethinking retirement plans
nd69bec70d1.summary: A US retiree is going ahead with retirement but is rethinking spending as the stock market has declined and uncertainty grows over Donald Trump's policies. The report is based on Reuters coverage.
nd69bec70d1.why: Equity market declines and policy uncertainty affect household wealth and consumer spending, which feeds into the broader US economy.

nb49b63301a.headline: More egg products seized at the border than fentanyl since the start of the year
nb49b63301a.summary: Federal statistics show more egg products were seized at the border than fentanyl since the start of the year. The data undermine the rationale for Donald Trump's trade war, according to The Independent.
nb49b63301a.why: Border seizure data reflect trade flows and enforcement, and they bear on how tariff policy is justified and enforced.

ne728794576.headline: CBDT Invites Public Suggestions on Income Tax Bill 2025
ne728794576.summary: The Central Board of Direct Taxes has issued an open call for stakeholder inputs on provisions of the newly introduced Income Tax Bill, 2025. The consultation covers the bill's provisions.
ne728794576.why: Income tax rules shape corporate and individual tax liabilities, which affects investment planning and corporate earnings in India.

nd85b9ec7f5.headline: How FAAC disbursed N15.26trn to Federal, States, LGs in 2024 – NEITI
nd85b9ec7f5.summary: The Federation Accounts Allocation Committee disbursed an unprecedented N15.26 trillion to federal, state and local governments in 2024. The figure was reported by NEITI.
nd85b9ec7f5.why: FAAC allocates Nigeria's federally collected revenues among government tiers, affecting public spending and the fiscal position of states.

n141e424900.headline: The White House Crypto Summit: A new era for digital finance and its impact on PNG
n141e424900.summary: The White House Crypto Summit 2025 gathered policymakers, crypto industry leaders and financial regulators to discuss digital assets and blockchain regulation. The meeting was hosted by the Trump administration.
n141e424900.why: Government policy on digital assets and blockchain regulation shapes the operating environment and valuations across the crypto sector.

n7ea83c48c9.headline: We won't deploy troops to Ukraine - Italy cautions EU on US trade war
n7ea83c48c9.summary: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni warned European partners on Tuesday against escalating a trade dispute with the United States through retaliatory measures.
n7ea83c48c9.why: Transatlantic tariff disputes affect European exporters, supply chains and the outlook for EU trade policy.

n25902680b3.headline: China renews export registrations for US pork, poultry plants providing relief to farmers
n25902680b3.summary: Beijing has renewed registrations allowing hundreds of US pork and poultry facilities to export to China, industry groups said on Monday, after lapses threatened shipments.
n25902680b3.why: China is the world's largest meat importer, so its registration of foreign plants determines whether US meat producers can access that market. Export access affects farm incomes and meat prices.

naa77e21e0b.headline: Seasonality drove down inflation – Rewane
naa77e21e0b.summary: Nigeria's headline inflation declined further to 23.18% year on year, the statistics office said on Monday. Economist Rewane attributed the fall largely to seasonal factors.
naa77e21e0b.why: Inflation data shapes central bank policy and currency expectations, which matter to investors in Nigerian assets. Nigeria is Africa's largest economy by population and a major oil producer.

n14bef20d3e.headline: Asda is axing 6,000 products from its supermarket range across the UK
n14bef20d3e.summary: UK supermarket chain Asda is removing around 6,000 products from its range over the next few months as it makes changes to its offer.
n14bef20d3e.why: Asda is one of the UK's largest supermarket chains, owned by TDR Capital and the Issa brothers. Range cuts reflect how grocers manage costs and shelf space.

n9d0dedb6b8.headline: Hardship: Nigeria's inflation drops signal economic recovery - CPPE, Economists
n9d0dedb6b8.summary: Economists and the Centre for the Promotion of Private Enterprise say two consecutive drops in Nigeria's inflation rate signal economic recovery. The report cites hardship faced by households.
n9d0dedb6b8.why: Inflation trends shape the central bank's interest rate decisions and the purchasing power of households and businesses in Nigeria.

n01adf044e4.headline: Many Dutch municipalities not preparing for looming budget cuts in 2026
n01adf044e4.summary: Dutch municipalities raised spending in 2025 despite budget cuts due in 2026, with many not setting aside financial buffers. Statistics Netherlands data shows 80 billion euros budgeted, up 7.2%.
n01adf044e4.why: Dutch municipalities are local governments funded largely by national transfers and local taxes, so their budgets affect public services and local investment.

n0251a7b4af.headline: Intel's new CEO plots overhaul of manufacturing and AI operations
n0251a7b4af.summary: Intel's new chief executive plans to restructure the company's AI approach and cut staff. He cited a slow-moving and bloated middle management layer as a problem to address.
n0251a7b4af.why: Intel is a major US semiconductor maker that designs chips and runs chip factories. Restructuring plans affect its competitiveness in manufacturing and AI chips.

impacts.name: Intel
impacts.why: The new CEO's plan covers manufacturing and AI restructuring, including staff cuts.

neaae2f1a0a.headline: Gold at Rs 90k and silver at Rs 1 lakh: How should investors approach the highs? - BusinessToday
neaae2f1a0a.summary: Gold and silver prices hit historic highs in India, driven by global trade tensions and a weaker dollar. Motilal Oswal Financial Services suggests a 'buy on dips' strategy.
neaae2f1a0a.why: Gold and silver are traditional safe-haven assets, and their prices are sensitive to currency moves and geopolitical and trade uncertainty.
neaae2f1a0a.why_moved: The article attributes the record highs to global trade tensions and a weaker dollar.

ndc8a40af48.headline: IHS Holding Limited Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2024 Financial Results
ndc8a40af48.summary: IHS Holding Limited reported fourth-quarter and full-year 2024 results, which it says came in ahead of guidance. The company cited significant progress in delivering its strategic review.
ndc8a40af48.why: IHS Holding is a telecom tower operator with assets across Africa and Latin America, and its results reflect demand for wireless infrastructure in emerging markets.

nac96603930.headline: 10 fastest and slowest places for selling homes in North Wales - and the outlier
nac96603930.summary: New figures show which North Wales areas are selling homes most quickly and where transactions are slower. The data comes as the housing market appears to be picking up.
nac96603930.why: Local housing transaction speeds are a gauge of regional property demand, which feeds into mortgage lending and construction activity.

n42c8060349.headline: German Economic Sentiment Climbs After Politicians Pledge Ramp Up in Spending -- 2nd Update
n42c8060349.summary: Financial analysts became much more upbeat about Germany's economic prospects this month as lawmakers closed in on an agreement to raise spending on defense and infrastructure.
n42c8060349.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and fiscal spending changes influence growth expectations across the euro area.

n977d80215c.headline: First-home buyers need more than a rate cut, banks say
n977d80215c.summary: A recent RBA interest rate cut has triggered a surge in mortgage applications, but banks say the gains are not coming from first-home buyers. First-home buyers need more than a rate cut, banks say.
n977d80215c.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate that drives mortgage pricing and household borrowing across the country's banking system.

nafd0c3ed17.headline: How have Adani stocks performed amid the current market correction? - BusinessToday
nafd0c3ed17.summary: Adani Total Gas has fallen about 50%, with its price dropping to Rs 603 from a 52-week high of Rs 1,198. The decline comes amid a broader market correction.
nafd0c3ed17.why: Adani Total Gas is a city gas distributor in India, part of the Adani group of companies.

nf39c8c2df2.headline: XPeng sees better-than-expected quarterly revenue on new markets, cheaper SUVs
nf39c8c2df2.summary: XPeng forecast first-quarter revenue of 15 billion to 15.7 billion yuan, with the midpoint above analyst expectations. The company cited new markets and cheaper SUVs.
nf39c8c2df2.why: XPeng is a Chinese electric vehicle maker, and its quarterly revenue trends indicate demand for its models in China and abroad.

impacts.name: XPeng
impacts.why: The company's revenue forecast for the quarter was above analyst expectations at the midpoint.

nae6d3a7c84.headline: STI up 0.9% as regional stocks rise on strong US retail sales data
nae6d3a7c84.summary: The Straits Times Index rose 0.9% as regional stocks gained on strong US retail sales data. Seatrium was the top gainer on the index, while CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust was the biggest decliner.
nae6d3a7c84.why: The Straits Times Index is Singapore's benchmark equity index, tracking the largest listed companies on the Singapore Exchange. Its moves reflect regional sentiment and global demand signals.
nae6d3a7c84.why_moved: Regional stocks rose on strong US retail sales data, according to the headline.

nd9d1c28d3c.headline: US Government bans DeepSeek on Government devices
nd9d1c28d3c.summary: US government employees were told by internal email not to access or download DeepSeek-related applications or websites. The restriction applies to government devices.
nd9d1c28d3c.why: DeepSeek is a Chinese artificial intelligence company, and restrictions on its tools affect the competitive landscape for AI providers and government technology procurement.

n3a61a45d61.headline: Insulet Announces Proposed Financing Transactions
n3a61a45d61.summary: Insulet Corporation announced its intention to offer, subject to market and other conditions, $450 million of securities in proposed financing transactions.
n3a61a45d61.why: Insulet makes the Omnipod insulin pump system, and its financing choices affect its balance sheet and capacity for growth.

n0026e3b3f9.headline: Nicolai Tangen secures another term as Norway
n0026e3b3f9.summary: Nicolai Tangen has been appointed to a second term as chief executive of Norway's sovereign wealth fund, Reuters reported.
n0026e3b3f9.why: Norway's sovereign wealth fund is one of the world's largest investors, and its leadership shapes large global equity and bond allocations.

n7b065ebab6.headline: Fraport looks to airports outside Germany for passengers as Frankfurt stagnates
n7b065ebab6.summary: Frankfurt airport operator Fraport AG is increasingly relying on airports it manages outside Germany for revenue, as weak passenger numbers at domestic airports weigh on results.
n7b065ebab6.why: Fraport operates Frankfurt airport and airports worldwide, so its revenue mix reflects both German air travel demand and international airport management.

n77e086b26b.headline: DA hike 2025: AICPI IW index slashed 0.5 points ahead of expected DA raise for central govt staff - BusinessToday
n77e086b26b.summary: The AICPI-IW index was cut by 0.5 points ahead of an expected dearness allowance hike for central government staff, effective from January 1, 2025, with arrears payable.
n77e086b26b.why: The dearness allowance is an inflation-linked pay adjustment for Indian central government employees, and it is calculated from the AICPI-IW index.

ncf62ae0424.headline: Nearly half of all exported Irish goods went to the US in January - Main Topics - Kildare Nationalist
ncf62ae0424.summary: Nearly half of exported Irish goods went to the United States in January. Finance Minister Paschal Donohoe said Ireland needed to work with the US on the issues Washington has raised.
ncf62ae0424.why: Ireland is a small open economy with heavy exposure to US trade, so US tariff and trade policy directly affect its export sector and public finances.

n441a73c73d.headline: Believe in Make In India, it is giving good results: FM Sitharaman to Opposition
n441a73c73d.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman defended the Make in India initiative in the Rajya Sabha. She said it attracted Rs 1.5 lakh crore in investment and created nearly 9.5 lakh jobs.
n441a73c73d.why: Make in India is the government's programme to boost domestic manufacturing and attract foreign investment into India.

n9805b45328.headline: BYD Shares Surge On Ultra-Fast EV Charging Technology
n9805b45328.summary: BYD shares rallied on Tuesday after the company introduced charging technology that could power electric vehicles in nearly the time it takes to refuel a gasoline car.
n9805b45328.why: BYD is one of the world's largest electric vehicle makers, so charging technology affects its competitiveness against rivals.

impacts.name: BYD
impacts.why: The company's shares rallied on the announced charging technology.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n9805b45328.why_moved: The company introduced charging technology that could match refuelling times for gasoline cars. Investors tend to reward perceived gains in EV competitiveness.

na2ae2fcd2b.headline: LIC to acquire ‘substantial’ stake in pure health insurer, announcement likely by March 31
na2ae2fcd2b.summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India is in the final stage of discussions to acquire a substantial stake in a pure health insurance company, with an announcement likely by March 31.
na2ae2fcd2b.why: LIC is India's largest state-owned life insurer, and its investments can reshape competition in the country's fast-growing health insurance market.

n792f753a04.headline: And finally… poached eggs
n792f753a04.summary: Eggs are being smuggled into the US from Mexico and Canada to meet black market demand amid skyrocketing prices. The price of a dozen eggs roughly doubled in a year to a record $5.90 in February.
n792f753a04.why: Food prices are a key component of US inflation, so sharp moves in staples like eggs feed into consumer price data and central bank policy expectations.

n692b5a072f.headline: German lawmakers approve huge defense and infrastructure spending
n692b5a072f.summary: Friedrich Merz, Germany's incoming chancellor, won lawmakers' approval to loosen strict debt rules to allow higher defence spending. Doubts about the trans-Atlantic alliance are growing.
n692b5a072f.why: Germany's debt brake has long constrained federal borrowing. Changes to it shape German bond supply and the outlook for European defence and infrastructure companies.
n692b5a072f.why_moved: Parliamentary approval of looser debt rules allows higher defence and infrastructure spending, against a backdrop of doubts about the trans-Atlantic alliance.
